title: Settlement of the Value that Governs a Keyturn Vehicle Listing on a Class Move
content:
When a Keyturn Vehicle Listing is moved between value classes, the value that governs the listing is settled first and the class the listing is moved into is the class whose value band that governing value falls in.

The marketplace figure the settlement starts from is the vehicle value standing on the listing. That figure is rounded half away from zero to two decimal places, and the rounded figure is the value that governs the listing.

Where the vehicle's record calls for adjustments to the marketplace figure, each adjustment is a share applied to the figure the one before it produced, taken in the order mileage, service record and recovery history, and the figure so reached is rounded half away from zero to two decimal places before the host's own declared value is weighed against it.

### Worked through on hypothetical records

*A marketplace figure of 41500.00 USD with nothing further called for.* Rounded half away from zero to two decimal places the figure stands at 41500.00 USD, and that is the value that governs the listing. The class the listing is moved into is then the class whose published value band 41500.00 USD falls in.

*The same figure where the record calls for shares of 0.96, 1.02 and 0.99, in that order.* The first share acts on 41500.00 USD and gives 39840.00 USD; the second acts on that figure and gives 40636.80 USD; the third acts on that figure and gives 40230.43 USD once rounded half away from zero to two decimal places. Each share acts on the figure the one before it produced, in the order mileage, service record and recovery history, so the order in which they are taken is part of the figure reached.

*Where the halfway point falls.* A figure reached of 40230.435 USD rounds half away from zero to 40230.44 USD, and one of 40230.425 USD rounds to 40230.43 USD.
